product.name: NAAIL RiskOS™
product.subtitle: Evidence-grounded cross-domain enterprise risk intelligence
product.score_note: Composite risk score intentionally disabled until benchmark calibration and independent validation.

domains.name: CAM / Audit Judgment
domains.basis: Two FY2026 CAMs are mapped in the current Microsoft POC; both are high-judgment areas.
domains.evidence: FY2026 Deloitte CAM disclosures in Microsoft POC
domains.next_action: Map CAM procedures to account assertions, control evidence and year-over-year persistence.

domains.name: ICFR / Controls
domains.basis: Current POC records an unqualified ICFR opinion. This is not evidence of zero control risk.
domains.next_action: Add control-level evidence, deficiency history and independent exception testing.

domains.name: Finance / Market
domains.basis: FY2026 simple price return in the POC is -24.2%; financial margins remain strong. This is a market signal, not an audit finding.
domains.evidence: 251 IEX daily bars + SEC XBRL features
domains.next_action: Complete factor regression and benchmark against sector/market distributions.

domains.name: Disclosure / Text Risk
domains.basis: Bounded risk-factor sample has low readability and measurable uncertainty; source sample is too small for a company-wide conclusion.
domains.next_action: Run full-section chronology-safe NLP and compare against prior years and peers.

domains.name: IFRS Judgment
domains.basis: Microsoft reports under U.S. GAAP; IFRS should be used only as a cross-framework comparison layer in this POC.
domains.next_action: Map only comparable accounting judgments; do not label IFRS as the issuer's reporting basis.

domains.name: KAM
domains.basis: The Microsoft U.S. audit report uses the PCAOB CAM regime; KAM is a comparator, not the primary disclosure regime.
domains.next_action: Use KAM only for cross-jurisdiction benchmarking.

domains.name: AAER / Forensic
domains.basis: AAER is registered as forensic/adversarial evidence in NAAIL, but the current Microsoft POC has no executed company-specific AAER match artifact.
domains.evidence: NAAIL Free Data Fabric + Microsoft POC registry
domains.next_action: Run entity-resolved SEC AAER/enforcement matching and preserve negative results as evidence.

domains.name: Cybersecurity
domains.basis: Cybersecurity is in the platform scope, but the current Microsoft POC does not yet contain a dedicated executed cyber-risk evidence package.
domains.next_action: Ingest Item 1C / cyber disclosures, incident history and control/governance evidence with source timestamps.

domains.name: ESG / Sustainability
domains.basis: Microsoft sustainability reporting is registered in the POC source registry, but ESG analytics are not yet executed in the Microsoft POC.
domains.next_action: Run emissions/disclosure provenance, framework mapping and ESG assurance checks.

domains.name: PCAOB / Inspection Readiness
domains.basis: PCAOB standards and public inspection data can inform audit-risk context; firm-level inspection findings must not be treated as Microsoft engagement findings.
domains.next_action: Map audit procedures to PCAOB requirements without inferring engagement-specific deficiencies.

domains.name: Evidence Assurance
domains.basis: An executed Microsoft Evidence Passport exists for FY2026 XBRL evidence.
domains.next_action: Extend passports to cyber, ESG, AAER and PCAOB-derived context.

domains.name: Governance / Human Gate
domains.basis: Current Human Gate approves publication of the research prototype with limitations; production approval is NO.
domains.next_action: Require independent replication and benchmark calibration before any professional score is released.
